parts.problem_md:
An algorithm has been written in pseudocode to calculate a check digit for a four-digit number. The algorithm then outputs the five-digit number including the check digit. The algorithm stops when –1 is input as the fourth digit.

`01 Flag FALSE `
`02 REPEAT `
`03     Total 0 `
`04     FOR Counter 1 TO 4 `
`05         OUTPUT "Enter a digit ", Counter `
`06         INPUT Number[Counter] `
`07         Total Total + Number * Counter `
`08         IF Number[Counter] = 0 `
`09            THEN `
`equation``10              Flag `$\leftarrow$` TRUE `
`11         ENDIF `
`12      NEXT Counter `
`13      IF NOT Flag `
`14         THEN `
`15           Number[5] MOD(Total, 10) `
`16           FOR Counter 0 TO 5 `
`17             OUTPUT Number[Counter] `
`18           NEXT `
`19       ENDIF `
`20 UNTIL Flag`

The algorithm does not check that each input is a single digit. 
Identify the place in the algorithm where this check should occur.

**Write pseudocode for this check**. Your pseudocode must make sure that the input is a single digit and checks for –1
parts.solution_md:
An example of an algorithm could be:

`REPEAT `
`     OUTPUT "Enter a digit " `
`     INPUT Number[Counter] `
`UNTIL Number[Counter] = Round(Number[Counter],0) AND ((Number[Counter] = -1) OR (Number[Counter] > 0 AND Number[Counter] < 10))`

**One mark** for place in algorithm (max one)

- around lines 05 and 06  **[1 mark]**
- line 07 **[1 mark]**
- (immediately) after the input of the number **[1 mark]**

**Three marks **pseudocode

Any **three **of the following:

- Use of `REPEAT … UNTIL `**OR** any working loop structure **[1 mark]**
- check for` >0 // >=0 `**[1 mark]**
- check for `<10 // >9 `**[1 mark]**
- check for whole number **[1 mark]**
- check for -1  [**1 mark]**
- check for length of digit <> 1 **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
The variables P and Q are used to store data in a program. P stores a string. Q stores a character.

**Write a pseudocode algorithm** to:

- convert P to upper case
- find the position of Q in the string P (the first character in this string is in position 1)
- store the position of Q in the variable Position
parts.solution_md:
An example algorithm could be:

`P `$\leftarrow$` UCASE(P) `
`Counter  `$\leftarrow$` 1 `
`Position  `$\leftarrow$` 0 `
`REPEAT `
`  IF SUBSTRING(P, Counter, 1) = Q `
`    THEN `
`      Position  `$\leftarrow$` Counter `
`  ENDIF `
`  Counter  `$\leftarrow$` Counter + 1 `
`UNTIL Position <> 0 OR Counter = LENGTH(P)`

Any **four **of the following:

- converting P to upper case **[1 mark]**
- finding the length of P **[1 mark]**
- using a loop to check for position of Q **[1 mark]**
- using the string operation substring **[1 mark]**
- storing the loop counter in Position if the value is found **[1 mark]**
